title: Ling Ying and the Old Leader
summary: A hidden protector named Ling Ying steps out to shield Xiao Yan from the Covering Sun Cloud Formation. He says he comes from beyond the Jia Ma Empire and has orders to bring Xiao Yan back unharmed, because his Young Lady wishes to protect him. With his Ten Thousand Binding Shadows he breaks the formation, and onlookers judge him at least a Seven-Star Dou Huang. Yun Leng then calls out Yun Shan, the sect's old leader, who has broken through to Dou Zong in seclusion. Yun Shan hears Yun Leng blame Xiao Yan for everything and decides the sect's reputation must be restored. He beats Hai Bodong, Ling Ying and the Heaven Swallowing Python and orders Xiao Yan to stay in the sect for a few years.
events: Ling Ying appears and shames the Misty Cloud Sect for attacking a youth.
He says he must bring Xiao Yan back unharmed on someone else's orders.
Ten Thousand Binding Shadows; Ling Ying breaks the formation.
Hai Bodong recognises him as someone who once spared him.
Yun Shan, the former leader, comes out of seclusion as a Dou Zong.
Yun Leng blames Xiao Yan for Mo Cheng's death and the damage to the sect.
Yun Shan defeats Hai Bodong, Ling Ying and the python and tells Xiao Yan to stay.
